qualification.details: High-Performance Director: Master Sports (MSI / PHD / MBA) with at least 10 Years of Research Experience OR Eminent players having represented India in Senior Category with at least 5 Years of sports management / Research experience OR Eminent Coach having trained India Player with at least 10 years of sports management / research experience. Head Coach (Athletics): Diploma in Coaching from SAI / NS NIS or recognized Indian / Foreign University, represented India in Olympics / World Cup / World Championship, Certificate Course from National / International Federation, working knowledge of computer, Minimum 10 years of coaching experience OR Experience in Coaching with Senior / Junior Indian teams or Decoration of Dronacharya / Arjuna / Dhyanchand or produced medallists in international competitions. Physiologist: MBBS / Masters in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology, Minimum 2 years of work experience as Sports / Exercise Physiologist or worked with National level sports organization. Masseur: Passed 10+2 from recognized board with Certificate Course/Skill development program for Masseur / Masseuse / Massage Therapy / Sports Masseur from recognized institution, Minimum 2 years of work experience as Masseur/Masseuse. Doctor / Sports Injury / Management Team: MD or Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine recognized by erstwhile MCI / Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine OR Minimum two years of research / work experience with the National / State athletes for MD in Sports Medicine.

content_sections.heading: KISCE Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available - 1 for High-Performance Director, 1 for Head Coach (Athletics), 1 for Physiologist, 3 for Masseur and 1 for Doctor / Sports Injury / Management Team.

content_sections.heading: KISCE Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: High-Performance Director: Master Sports (MSI / PHD / MBA) with at least 10 Years of Research Experience OR Eminent players having represented India in Senior Category with at least 5 Years of sports management / Research experience OR Eminent Coach having trained India Player with at least 10 years of sports management / research experience. Head Coach (Athletics): Diploma in Coaching from SAI / NS NIS or recognized Indian / Foreign University, represented India in Olympics / World Cup / World Championship, Certificate Course from National / International Federation, working knowledge of computer, Minimum 10 years of coaching experience OR Experience in Coaching with Senior / Junior Indian teams or Decoration of Dronacharya / Arjuna / Dhyanchand or produced medallists in international competitions. Physiologist: MBBS / Masters in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology, Minimum 2 years of work experience as Sports / Exercise Physiologist or worked with National level sports organization. Masseur: Passed 10+2 from recognized board with Certificate Course/Skill development program for Masseur / Masseuse / Massage Therapy / Sports Masseur from recognized institution, Minimum 2 years of work experience as Masseur/Masseuse. Doctor / Sports Injury / Management Team: MD or Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine recognized by erstwhile MCI / Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine OR Minimum two years of research / work experience with the National / State athletes for MD in Sports Medicine.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for KISCE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the KISCE Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various posts including High Performance Director, Head Coach, Physiologist, Masseur, and Doctor in the Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for KISCE Recruitment 2026 is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to KISCE posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in the KISCE Recruitment 2026 is 65 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for most posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the KISCE posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the posts in KISCE Recruitment 2026 ranges from ₹35,000 to ₹1,50,000 per month, depending on the post and experience of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Masseur post?
faq.answer: For the Masseur post, candidates must have passed 10+2 from a recognized board and possess a Certificate Course/Skill development program for Masseur/Masseuse/Massage Therapy/Sports Masseur from a recognized institution, along with at least 2 years of work experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the KISCE Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for KISCE Recruitment 2026 will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q9. Which city and state are these KISCE vacancies located in?
faq.answer: The KISCE vacancies are located in Leh city, Ladakh state, with a pincode of 194103. This is a contract-based recruitment opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the KISCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job type for the KISCE Recruitment 2026 is contract-based. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis for the specified period.
